review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this intentionally pending case. The original PRD explicitly leaves the material DEC-001 unresolved: AC-001 and AC-002 describe conditional acceptance under the recommended option, not authorization to select it. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001, evidence through repository, requirements, and decisions, and no assignable tasks or assignment expectations. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 retain their original stable keys. The complete supplied source supports index.js and index.d.ts as the implementation and maintained public-type owners; limitFunction forwards clearQueue and derives its declaration through Pick rather than introducing another separately maintained owner. test.js and index.test-d.ts are the appropriate regression and type-verification scope, and package.json establishes the xo && ava && tsd verification entry point. The empty team catalog does not invalidate this expectation because the material decision gate precedes Scenario Coverage, independent-review prerequisites, and assignment eligibility. Gold and preview releaseInput fields agree on repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budget, and metric-policy fingerprints. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining-work list are preparation-state records, not conflicting final readiness expectations. Historical project reuse and retained operations do not supply a decision or candidate evidence. This approval concerns the frozen planning expectation only; it does not resolve DEC-001, authorize implementation, attest human confirmation, or establish test success. I relied on the supplied Service-bound digests and performed no digest recomputation, code execution, or candidate-based adjustment.
